info.name: Clerk Backend Account Portal OAuth Applications API
Get a List of OAuth Applications for an Instance

params.name: limit
params.description:
Applies a limit to the number of results returned.
Can be used for paginating the results together with `offset`.

params.name: offset
params.description:
Skip the first `offset` results when paginating.
Needs to be an integer greater or equal to zero.
To be used in conjunction with `limit`.

params.name: order_by
params.description:
Allows to return OAuth applications in a particular order.
At the moment, you can order the returned OAuth applications by their `created_at` and `name`.
In order to specify the direction, you can use the `+/-` symbols prepended in the property to order by.
For example, if you want OAuth applications to be returned in descending order according to their `created_at` property, you can use `-created_at`.
If you don't use `+` or `-`, then `+` is implied. We only support one `order_by` parameter, and if multiple `order_by` parameters are provided, we will only keep the first one. For example,
if you pass `order_by=name&order_by=created_at`, we will consider only the first `order_by` parameter, which is `name`. The `created_at` parameter will be ignored in this case.

params.name: name_query
params.description: Returns OAuth applications with names that match the given query, via case-insensitive partial match.

items.docs:
This request returns the list of OAuth applications for an instance.
Results can be paginated using the optional `limit` and `offset` query parameters.
The OAuth applications are ordered by descending creation date.
Most recent OAuth applications will be returned first.

Creates a new OAuth application with the given name and callback URL for an instance.
The callback URL must be a valid URL.
All URL schemes are allowed such as `http://`, `https://`, `myapp://`, etc...

info.name: Retrieve an OAuth Application by ID

params.name: oauth_application_id
params.description: The ID of the OAuth application

items.docs: Fetches the OAuth application whose ID matches the provided `id` in the path.

params.name: oauth_application_id
params.description: The ID of the OAuth application to update

params.name: oauth_application_id
params.description: The ID of the OAuth application to delete

items.docs:
Deletes the given OAuth application.
This is not reversible.

info.name: Upload a Logo for the OAuth Application

params.name: oauth_application_id
params.description: The ID of the OAuth application for which to upload a logo

items.docs:
Set or replace an OAuth application's logo by uploading an image file.
This endpoint uses the `multipart/form-data` request content type and accepts a file of image type.
The file size cannot exceed 10MB.
Only the following file content types are supported: `image/jpeg`, `image/png`, `image/gif`, `image/webp`.

info.name: Rotate the Client Secret of the Given OAuth Application

params.name: oauth_application_id
params.description: The ID of the OAuth application for which to rotate the client secret

items.docs:
Rotates the OAuth application's client secret.
When the client secret is rotated, make sure to update it in authorized OAuth clients.
